summary: The candidate fully addresses the open documentation feature request by expanding the existing Slurm section from one flawed multi-node serving example to tested single-node serving, corrected multi-node serving, offline inference, and Apptainer/Singularity patterns. The original base reproducibly fails all five candidate regressions, including the substantive task-rank check; the exact candidate passes those regressions and independent static adversarial checks. This verifies the documentation change, not execution on a real Slurm cluster.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d923f996212b/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/test_slurm_documentation.py (candidate test temporarily placed over recorded base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison at the exact recorded base: 5/5 tests failed because the page had only three Bash blocks, used outer-shell SLURM_NODEID and --tp, and lacked offline and container examples.
The exact candidate passed all five regression tests against source imported from /job/repo/python/sglang.

tests.command: independent inline Python adversarial checker over docs/docs/references/multi_node_deployment/multi_node.mdx
tests.what_was_measured: Independently found and bash -n parsed all seven Bash blocks; compiled the embedded offline Python; checked every launch fragment for --model-path; checked two-node/task/GPU/tensor-parallel consistency, task-local SLURM_PROCID, per-task %n logs, bounded health polling, and NVIDIA/ROCm container guidance.
Regression-test Python syntax and existing documentation navigation JSON syntax.

gpu_execution_evidence: The host exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) through Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but is not a Slurm allocation and has no sbatch/srun. A local one-GPU run would not validate the documented scheduler, two-node network, rank, or container paths, so no unrelated GPU smoke is claimed.
native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate changes only one MDX document, one Python documentation test, and report artifacts; no C/C++/CUDA/HIP/native source or native import path changed, so no native rebuild applies.
remaining_counterexamples: A site where Slurm GPU resources are requested with a mechanism other than --gres=gpu:N requires the documented site-specific substitution.
A multi-node site whose selected default network interface is not routable requires NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME/GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME or RCCL-specific configuration as the candidate warns.
AMD container execution requires replacing Apptainer --nv with --rocm; that path was not available for execution here.
Actual Llama 405B or DeepSeek V3/R1 loading and two-node numerical output remain unexecuted because the necessary allocation and weights were unavailable.
remaining_limitations: No sbatch, srun, Apptainer/Singularity, or Mintlify CLI was installed, so scheduler submission, container GPU passthrough, and rendered-site validation were unavailable.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) was assigned; no NVIDIA architecture or multi-node NCCL/RCCL fabric was available.
The candidate's runtime-oriented examples are therefore verified statically and against the live CLI surface, not end to end on Slurm.
No native code changed, so native rebuild and compiler/ISA validation are not applicable.
